deviation.description: The canonized E1-R result contained a literal backslash-n sequence after the closing JSON object, making the full file invalid JSON.

normalization.operation: Remove only the trailing literal backslash-n sequence outside the JSON object.

evidence_rule: The original result remains preserved; the normalized copy is the sole parseable representation eligible for structural audit. No scientific record may be added, removed, recoded, retried, or imputed.
